# Documentation

## Introduction

Find specifications, guidance, and authoring workflows in this checkout. Documents remain at their source locations; appearing here does not make an implementation example or draft an approved design rule.

## Contributing

Add or edit ordinary Markdown beside its owning code or in the book's authored-content directories. The library discovers documents within the configured source locations. No chapter registration is needed to make a document findable.

Use source-section bindings when guidance should also appear within a curated chapter. Keep definitions and values in product code, and reference existing guidance instead of copying it.
